recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not re-create the removed FHIR-core snomedct.html page or duplicate THO wording in core; future wording changes for SNOMED CT usage guidance should be made through THO/UTG unless a FHIR-core link becomes incorrect.
issue_request: FHIR-13408 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 vocabulary issue asking to clarify the old FHIR-core SNOMED CT Version Issues section so implementers understand terminology-service defaults when no version URI or no release date is supplied, and so date-only version strings are treated as errors per the additional comment.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git/SVN commit 716c57421852089f5d4b87df378fc2ca0ccaccb0, 'GF#13408 - clarifications about SCT Uri', which updated source/snomedct.html with the date-only error rule, the minimum http://snomed.info/sct/[sctid] URI form, and the no-version/no-date defaulting guidance.
additional_context: Later Published issue FHIR-35933 moved the external code-system guidance pages from FHIR core to HL7 Terminology (THO). Its implementation commit 81e5862f203fdb8a03e9c943a7cf455aba8973f4 deleted source/snomedct.html, left only the local SNOMED CT usage report in source/hierarchy.xml, and changed core pages to link to https://terminology.hl7.org/SNOMEDCT.html. The current THO SNOMED CT Versions section includes the relevant FHIR-13408 language.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. Current FHIR-core source is correct because it points readers to THO for authoritative SNOMED CT usage guidance, and THO already carries the requested clarification.
